summary: Implemented the show_speed feature. rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed (default False), a static render_speed helper using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a speed branch in render when total is unknown; track() gains show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track infers total as explicit value, then sequence length, then None, without raising for non-Sized iterables. tests/test_progress.py: added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track. CHANGELOG.md: added the Unreleased/Added line. Not run: tests, mypy, black (per instructions). Not committed. One gap: no test yet for track() over a generator showing speed.
